name: bun
description: The inspected Bun self-updater supports a narrow primary C observation: release bytes are checked against a GitHub-derived digest and the candidate executable is version-checked before replacement. The source also exposes an environment-controlled TLS rejection setting, so the transport trust boundary is not simply fixed by this function.
limitations: Newly retrieved snapshot at the recorded commit, not historical release verification.
The source does not show a signing-key check; the digest source and GitHub API response are external to this repository.
Platform-specific replacement details are outside the cited body.
